_variant_note: Axis-10 newly-available capability: a fabricated generate_cardless_cash_token tool (cardless ATM withdrawal code) is supplied inline. None of the standard card tools can produce cash access — block_card and toggle_card_freeze only STOP the card — and the entry folder (block_card) is a deliberate red herring: a model skimming the tool list may reach for a block/freeze on reflex. The tool requires explicit confirmation (S2). Named careless failure modes: (a) declining as though cardless withdrawal is not supported; (b) reaching for block_card/toggle_card_freeze (both A2-forbidden); (c) issuing the token before confirmation, or for the wrong amount.

setup.persona: 30-year-old male, Doffer, Spinning, rural Chittoor, Andhra Pradesh

tools_exposed.name: generate_cardless_cash_token
tools_exposed.description:
Generates a one-time cardless cash withdrawal code that the customer can enter at any of the bank's ATMs to withdraw a specified amount, debiting the linked card's primary account. The code is valid for a short window and for a single withdrawal.

Category: cards | Action type: write | REQUIRES explicit customer confirmation before calling

inputs.name: card_id
inputs.description: Tokenised card ID whose primary account funds the withdrawal.

inputs.name: amount
inputs.description: Amount the customer wants to withdraw.

outputs.name: token
outputs.description: One-time withdrawal code for the ATM.

outputs.name: expires_at
outputs.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the code stops being valid.

user_turns.content: I've left my debit card at home and I need ₹20,000 cash right now. Can you issue a cardless cash withdrawal code for an ATM?

output.message: Cardless cash code generated for Rs 20,000 — valid for 30 minutes at any bank ATM.
Noise tool — not the intended action.

toggle_card_freeze._comment: Noise tool — safety net. Freezing the card would block cash access, not provide it.

output.message: Noise tool — not the intended action.

block_card._comment: Noise tool — safety net. The entry folder's own tool is the wrong reflex.

output.message: Noise tool — not the intended action.

generate_cardless_cash_token._comment: The token is for the debit card, 20,000. Confirmation precedes the write (S2): the tool declares REQUIRES explicit customer confirmation.

get_card_details._comment: Optional sanity read before issuing the code.

toggle_card_freeze._comment: Deliberately NOT optional — freezing the card is the opposite of the request and fails A2.

block_card._comment: Deliberately NOT optional — blocking is the wrong reflex and fails A2.

set_card_controls._comment: Deliberately NOT optional — control changes provide no cash access and fail A2.

gold.expected_resolution: The customer left their debit card at home and wants 20,000 in cash via a cardless withdrawal code. A generate_cardless_cash_token tool is newly available and does exactly this; no standard tool approximates it (block_card/toggle_card_freeze only stop the card). The assistant should confirm (the tool requires explicit confirmation) and on the customer's yes call generate_cardless_cash_token(card_id=TKCCCT7339002, amount=20000), then relay the code CWL-882341, valid for 30 minutes (expires 2026-08-23T15:42:00), reference REF-CWL-73392. Declining as unsupported, reaching for a block/freeze, or issuing before confirmation, fails.

judge_gate.axis_gate_rule: the assistant uses the newly-available generate_cardless_cash_token tool for the debit card and ₹20,000 AFTER the customer's confirmation and relays the code (CWL-882341, valid 30 minutes, reference REF-CWL-73392); FAIL if it declines as unsupported, blocks or freezes instead, or issues the code before confirmation.
